about.Description: An app for planning tasks, tracking progress, and organizing your day.

help.SwipeSwitch description: The bottom navigation panel has a SwipeSwitch. Swipe left, right, up, or down to switch between screens. Tapping the active item opens an extra menu.
help.SwipeSwitch dots: A 2×3 grid of dots shows the current position. The active dot matches the selected screen.
help.SwipeSwitch columns:
Columns (top to bottom):
• All Tasks / Scheme
• Day / Calendar (month)
• Task / Progress
help.Add category description: On the All Tasks screen, create a category to group tasks. Categories help structure the list and find tasks faster.
help.Add task description: You can add a task on the All Tasks screen inside a category or on the selected day screen. A task has a title, a block scheme, and completion state by day.
help.Add block description: Open a task and add a block via the editor toolbar. Blocks form the task content: text, lists, timers, counters, and other elements.
help.Block types description:
• Paragraph — plain text
• Bulleted and numbered lists
• Expandable block and expandable headings 1–4
• Timer — countdown or count-up
• Stopwatch — time measurement
• Counter — numeric value with units and a goal
help.Block journal description: In block settings you can enable “Journal by day”. Then the block state (e.g. a checked checkbox or counter value) is stored per day. “Show in stats” includes the block on the progress screen.
